### Taikomoji ekonomika

Groups: 6 · Skills: 18

[appliedEconomics.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/appliedEconomics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Specialized markets and institutional conditions in cities, housing, transport, education, healthcare, and agriculture create distinct economic mechanisms. This domain examines sector-specific choices and consequences without duplicating geographic, medical, educational, or agricultural competencies.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Tyrinėk, kaip ekonomikos principai taikomi miestams, būstui, transportui, švietimui, sveikatai ir žemės ūkiui.

Skills: 3

[agriculturalEconomics.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/agriculturalEconomics/agriculturalEconomics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Biological cycles, uncertain weather, land use, and international exchange shape agricultural markets.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Sužinok, kodėl ūkininkavimas turi savitų sąnaudų ir rizikų.

[agriculturalMarkets.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/agriculturalEconomics/skills/agriculturalMarkets.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Analyze farm-product prices in light of seasonality, storage opportunities, harvest variations, and international trade.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Tyrinėk, kodėl maisto kainos keičiasi dėl sezonų, derliaus ir prekybos.

[agriculturalSeasonalityAndRisk.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/agriculturalEconomics/skills/agriculturalSeasonalityAndRisk.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate how seasonal cycles, weather shocks, and variable costs influence production and options for insurance or hedging.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Suprask, kaip ūkininkai valdo sezoninį neapibrėžtumą ir orų riziką.

[economicsOfEducation.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/economicsOfEducation/economicsOfEducation.data.ts)

### Vartotojų elgsena

Groups: 3 · Skills: 13

[consumerBehavior.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/consumerBehavior.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Consumers evaluate needs, quality, alternatives, and information under varying incomes and psychological constraints. This domain analyzes their choices rather than sellers' methods of promoting goods.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Sužinok, kaip žmonės renkasi pirkinius ir kokia informacija juos veikia.

#### Elgsenos veiksniai renkantis

Skills: 4

[behavioralFactorsInChoice.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/behavioralFactorsInChoice/behavioralFactorsInChoice.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Limited attention and rationality, time preferences, presentation formats, and defaults can alter economic choices even when the formal options are unchanged.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Tyrinėk, kaip pasirinkimų pateikimas veikia sprendimus.

##### Ribotas racionalumas

[boundedRationality.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/behavioralFactorsInChoice/skills/boundedRationality.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how limits of time, knowledge, or computational ability lead decision-makers to use simplified rules.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Suprask, kodėl žmonės dažnai remiasi supaprastintomis taisyklėmis, užuot palyginę visas galimybes.

##### Pasirinkimų architektūra

[choiceArchitecture.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/behavioralFactorsInChoice/skills/choiceArchitecture.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess how default options, presentation order, and the difficulty of opting out affect choices without changing the underlying alternatives.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Pastebėk, kaip numatytieji pasirinkimai ir jų išdėstymas gali nukreipti sprendimą.

##### Įrėminimo efektas

[framingEffect.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/behavioralFactorsInChoice/skills/framingEffect.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify how equivalent information framed as gains or losses can change the assessment of a choice.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Sužinok, kodėl tie patys faktai atrodo kitaip, kai pateikiami kaip nauda ar nuostolis.

##### Dabarties šališkumas

[presentBias.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/behavioralFactorsInChoice/skills/presentBias.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize systematic overvaluation of immediate benefits relative to delayed consequences.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Suprask, kodėl neatidėliotinas atlygis gali nusverti geresnį ateities rezultatą.

Skills: 4

[consumerInformationAndRights.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/consumerInformationAndRights/consumerInformationAndRights.data.ts)

Skills: 5

[needsAndPreferences.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/needsAndPreferences/needsAndPreferences.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate the change in utility from consuming an additional unit with relevant conditions held constant; distinguish it from total utility.

##### Naudingumas

[utility.data.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/needsAndPreferences/skills/utility.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret utility as a model of an individual's preferences and valuation of consumption alternatives without assuming an objective universal unit of satisfaction.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Suprask naudingumą kaip būdą nusakyti, ką žmogus vertina.
